info.title: ProdBnb Admin API
info.description: The /v1/admin/* surface only (Phase 11; Admin Console). Every endpoint requires a Supabase access token for a user holding the 'admin' role, and each names the admin team-role permission it needs (see GET /me). Base path is mounted at /v1/admin on the ProdBnb backend.

get.summary: Operational dashboard summary
Provider/config status -- booleans and enums only, never a credential (Phase 14)
List users (search/role/status filters, roles included per row)
User detail: profile + roles + email (Admin Auth API) + counts

post.summary: Suspend a user (reason required) -- cascades to their published locations only
Restore a suspended user -- republishes only locations its own suspension put down

get.summary: List locations (status/host_id/search filters)
Location detail (includes moderation_reason, suspended_by_host_suspension)

patch.summary: Correct a listing's content (not status). Audited with the fields changed.

get.summary: List bookings (booker_id/host_id/location_id/status/start_after/start_before filters)
Booking detail

post.summary: Cancel a booking via the existing, unmodified booking engine

get.summary: List payments (status/provider/booking_id/created_after/created_before filters)
Payment detail
List refunds (status/payment_id filters)

post.summary: Create a refund via the existing PaymentService/PaymentProvider architecture

get.summary: Delivery diagnostics only (status/provider/error_reason) -- never notification content
Immutable audit log (target_type/target_id/admin_id/action/created_after/created_before filters) -- no write endpoint exists
The calling admin: team role and the exact permissions it grants
Every admin and their team role

post.summary: Add an existing account to the admin team by email (super admin)

put.summary: Set a team role (super admin). The last super admin cannot be demoted (409).

delete.summary: Remove from the admin team (super admin). Booker/host roles are kept.

get.summary: Platform fee, tax and unpaid-hold window

patch.summary: Change platform settings (super admin). Applies to new bookings only; audited.

get.summary: Every integration's configuration status (never a secret value); ?check=true runs live checks
Marketplace analytics for a range (bucketed by day/week/month in the given time zone)

post.summary: Grant booker/host on a user's behalf (audited). 'admin' is the team API's job.

delete.summary: Revoke booker/host (audited). Existing listings are not touched.

get.summary: Every photo on a listing: the general gallery and each section's

post.summary: Remove a photo/video from a listing (deletes the stored object; audited)
Remove an empty section from a listing (audited)

get.summary: Categories / amenities / use-cases, with how many listings use each

post.summary: Add a catalog option (audited; duplicate names are 409)

delete.summary: Delete an unused catalog option (409 while any listing uses it; audited)

post.summary: Reject on the host's behalf, optional reason (audited)
Re-check a payment with the provider (same guarded path as the webhook; audited)

get.summary: Money taken for a cancelled/rejected booking and not yet fully refunded
Find conversations -- metadata only, never message text

post.summary: Read a conversation for a stated reason. Writes a permanent access record first.

get.summary: Every admin read of private correspondence, with its reason (append-only)
